text: Victor Hernandez is a lifelong resident of Orange County, born in Santa Ana, now living in Brea. Victor's vision places working families over corporate greed and ensures resident status never dictates quality of life. He fiercely advocates for affordable housing, healthcare for all, defending our communities, taking money out of politics, and protecting our natural resources. He is ready to amplify our community's voice at the State Assembly. And Victor will serve his constituents without taking a dime of corporate or SuperPAC money—ever.

The son of immigrants, he co-developed a low-cost mobile healthcare service with his wife to support under-served children and adults, prioritizing and protecting their health and safety. As a board member of the California United for Single Payer (CUSP), Victor advocates for the CalCare universal healthcare bill. He builds coalitions by coordinating and supporting campaigns, direct actions, and mutual aid with multiple community organizations. Victor helped revive the Orange County Green Party, and his activism and community-building include reaching out across the political spectrum to find common ground.

District 59 deserves a State Assemblymember who will work to earn votes, never taking them for granted.Victor strongly believes elected officials should represent, not ignore, the people they serve–Victor is fully ready to show District 59 what true service looks like! He'll use his years of organizing experience across a wide range of goals and interests to build a coalition that listens and answers to the wonderful communities which comprise our district.
